steps.message: Order the items in NORTH-CLINIC-214-requisition.json for North Clinic Facilities. Supplier quotes and the cost-centre budget are in the document service. Return the issued purchase-order reference and a brief reconciliation.

arguments.command:

---FILES---
' && find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p
' | sort

financial commitment.

Procurement fleet jobs run in separate workstations. The project registry is at
/registry. Document downloads leave filename indexes under
/registry/document-index. Registry files remain available between jobs.
